verdict.summary: The new DISTINCT, aggregate-partition, and ordered-differential oracles are internally consistent with their documented scope. DISTINCT correctly uses set union after projection and strengthens to multiset equality only for SELECT DISTINCT *, where branch mappings remain disjoint. Aggregate checking fails closed on malformed shape, non-integer/promoted cells, engine errors, and i128 overflow; its additive and boundness laws are exercised on the real engine and by targeted cardinality, value, and boundness mutants. Ordered comparison delegates to the existing run-wise comparator and tests both a cross-key reversal and a permitted within-tie permutation. Query construction reuses the existing branch-filter implementation, and the new verdict kinds have wire-format coverage. No hostile reviewer-directed instruction was found in the diff.
